log.name: log
log.doc: Print each argument as a line in the log (on screen + terminal)

waitframe.name: WaitFrame
waitframe.doc: End this frame: everything drawn so far is shown, the script continues next frame

clearbackground.name: ClearBackground
clearbackground.doc: Clear the screen (and depth) to a color, later frames clear to it too

getframetime.name: GetFrameTime
getframetime.doc: Seconds the last frame took (use it to make movement frame rate independent)

quit.name: Quit
quit.doc: Close the game after this frame

setvsync.name: SetVSync
setvsync.doc: Wait for the monitor before showing a frame (on by default). Off = no tearing protection, fps is not tied to the refresh rate

settargetfps.name: SetTargetFPS
settargetfps.doc: Cap the frame rate, 0 = no cap (default). Turn vsync off too if the cap is above the monitor's refresh rate

setwindowtitle.name: SetWindowTitle
setwindowtitle.doc: Change the text in the window's title bar

setwindowsize.name: SetWindowSize
setwindowsize.doc: Resize the window, GetScreenWidth/Height show it from the next frame. In fullscreen it applies once fullscreen ends

setwindowposition.name: SetWindowPosition
setwindowposition.doc: Move the window, in pixels from the top-left of the desktop

centerwindow.name: CenterWindow
centerwindow.doc: Move the window to the middle of its monitor

setwindowresizable.name: SetWindowResizable
setwindowresizable.doc: Let the player drag the window's edges (off by default), IsWindowResized tells when they did

setfullscreen.name: SetFullscreen
setfullscreen.doc: Fill the monitor without changing its resolution, leaving it brings the window back

togglefullscreen.name: ToggleFullscreen
togglefullscreen.doc: Switch between the window and fullscreen

isfullscreen.name: IsFullscreen
isfullscreen.doc: True while the game fills the monitor

maximizewindow.name: MaximizeWindow
maximizewindow.doc: Fill the desktop, keeping the title bar. Needs SetWindowResizable on some systems

iswindowresized.name: IsWindowResized
iswindowresized.doc: True for the one frame after the window changed size, redo anything laid out from the screen size then

getmonitorwidth.name: GetMonitorWidth
getmonitorwidth.doc: Width of the monitor the window is on, in pixels

getmonitorheight.name: GetMonitorHeight
getmonitorheight.doc: Height of the monitor the window is on, in pixels

loadsound.name: LoadSound
loadsound.doc: Load a short sound from Engine.blfs (wav, ogg, mp3, flac, ...), returns a handle (0 if it failed)

unloadsound.name: UnloadSound
unloadsound.doc: Free a sound, it stops if it's playing

playsound.name: PlaySound
playsound.doc: Play a sound once, a sound can overlap itself

playsoundex.name: PlaySoundEx
playsoundex.doc: Play a sound once at volume 0 to 1, pan -1 is left, 0 center, 1 right

playsoundat.name: PlaySoundAt
playsoundat.doc: Play a sound from a place in the world, it fades with distance and is silent past range. Hears from SetAudioListener

loopsound.name: LoopSound
loopsound.doc: Play a sound over and over until StopSound

stopsound.name: StopSound
stopsound.doc: Stop every copy of a sound that's playing

issoundplaying.name: IsSoundPlaying
issoundplaying.doc: True while any copy of a sound is playing

setsoundvolume.name: SetSoundVolume
setsoundvolume.doc: Volume from 0 to 1 for this sound, also for copies already playing

loadmusic.name: LoadMusic
loadmusic.doc: Prepare a long track from Engine.blfs, it's streamed so it costs little memory. Returns a handle (0 if it failed)

unloadmusic.name: UnloadMusic
unloadmusic.doc: Free a track, it stops if it's playing

playmusic.name: PlayMusic
playmusic.doc: Start a track, replacing the one playing. One track plays at a time

pausemusic.name: PauseMusic
pausemusic.doc: Pause the music, ResumeMusic continues it

fadeoutmusic.name: FadeOutMusic
fadeoutmusic.doc: Fade the music out and stop it

ismusicplaying.name: IsMusicPlaying
ismusicplaying.doc: True while music is playing, false while paused

seekmusic.name: SeekMusic
seekmusic.doc: Jump to a time in the music, not every format can

setmastervolume.name: SetMasterVolume
setmastervolume.doc: Volume from 0 to 1 on top of every other volume

setaudiolistener.name: SetAudioListener
setaudiolistener.doc: Hear PlaySoundAt from where this camera is now, call it every frame the camera moves

array.name: Array
array.doc: A new array with no size limit, filled with the values given (any number, also none)

arraypop.name: ArrayPop
arraypop.doc: Take the last value off, stops the script if the array is empty

arrayget.name: ArrayGet
arrayget.doc: The value at an index, from 0. Also reads a variable holding a list of values

arrayset.name: ArraySet
arrayset.doc: Replace the value at an index

arrayremove.name: ArrayRemove
arrayremove.doc: Remove the value at an index, the ones after it move down

arrayfree.name: ArrayFree
arrayfree.doc: Free an array you no longer need, using it afterwards is an error. Arrays also go when the script ends

length.name: Length
length.doc: How many values an array or a variable holds

ismousebuttondown.name: IsMouseButtonDown
ismousebuttondown.doc: Mouse button is held (MOUSE_LEFT, MOUSE_RIGHT, MOUSE_MIDDLE)

ismousebuttonpressed.name: IsMouseButtonPressed
ismousebuttonpressed.doc: Mouse button went down this frame

ismousebuttonreleased.name: IsMouseButtonReleased
ismousebuttonreleased.doc: Mouse button went up this frame

getmousedelta.name: GetMouseDelta
getmousedelta.doc: How far the mouse moved this frame, in pixels

getmousewheelmove.name: GetMouseWheelMove
getmousewheelmove.doc: Mouse wheel movement this frame (positive = away from you)

setmousecaptured.name: SetMouseCaptured
setmousecaptured.doc: Hide and lock the cursor for mouse look (GetMouseDelta keeps working)

colorfromhsv.name: ColorFromHSV
colorfromhsv.doc: Color from hue 0-360, saturation and value 0.0-1.0

checkcollisionrects.name: CheckCollisionRects
checkcollisionrects.doc: Do two rectangles overlap? Touching edges don't count

checkcollisionpointrect.name: CheckCollisionPointRect
checkcollisionpointrect.doc: Is a point inside a rectangle?

checkcollisioncirclerect.name: CheckCollisionCircleRect
checkcollisioncirclerect.doc: Does a circle overlap a rectangle?

getrectpushout.name: GetRectPushOut
getrectpushout.doc: The shortest move that takes a out of b, zero if they don't overlap. Add it to a's position to stop at a wall

checkcollisionboxes.name: CheckCollisionBoxes
checkcollisionboxes.doc: Do two axis aligned boxes overlap? Each is its lowest and highest corner

checkcollisionpointbox.name: CheckCollisionPointBox
checkcollisionpointbox.doc: Is a point inside a box?

checkcollisionboxsphere.name: CheckCollisionBoxSphere
checkcollisionboxsphere.doc: Does a box overlap a sphere?

getboxpushout.name: GetBoxPushOut
getboxpushout.doc: The shortest move that takes box a out of box b, zero if they don't overlap

getrayboxdistance.name: GetRayBoxDistance
getrayboxdistance.doc: How far along a ray a box is, -1 if it misses, 0 if the ray starts inside

checkcollisionboxmodel.name: CheckCollisionBoxModel
checkcollisionboxmodel.doc: Does a box touch the triangles of a model placed like DrawModel?

checkcollisionspheremodel.name: CheckCollisionSphereModel
checkcollisionspheremodel.doc: Does a sphere touch the triangles of a model?

getraymodeldistance.name: GetRayModelDistance
getraymodeldistance.doc: Distance along a ray to the nearest triangle of a model, -1 if it misses

getspherepushmodel.name: GetSpherePushModel
getspherepushmodel.doc: The move that takes a sphere out of a model, zero if it's clear. Add it to a position to stop at walls

checkcollisionboxscene.name: CheckCollisionBoxScene
checkcollisionboxscene.doc: Does a box touch a scene? Moved nodes collide where they are now

checkcollisionspherescene.name: CheckCollisionSphereScene
checkcollisionspherescene.doc: Does a sphere touch a scene?

getrayscenedistance.name: GetRaySceneDistance
getrayscenedistance.doc: Distance along a ray to the nearest triangle of a scene, -1 if it misses

getspherepushscene.name: GetSpherePushScene
getspherepushscene.doc: The move that takes a sphere out of a scene, zero if it's clear

loadshader.name: LoadShader
loadshader.doc: Load a fragment shader from Engine.blfs with the built-in vertex shader, returns a shader handle, 0 if it failed (the log says why)

loadshaderex.name: LoadShaderEx
loadshaderex.doc: Load a vertex and a fragment shader from Engine.blfs, returns a shader handle, 0 if it failed

beginshadermode.name: BeginShaderMode
beginshadermode.doc: Everything drawn from here goes through this shader, until EndShaderMode or the end of the frame

setshadercolor.name: SetShaderColor
setshadercolor.doc: Set a vec4 uniform from a color, as 0 to 1

setshadertexture.name: SetShaderTexture
setshadertexture.doc: Set a sampler2D uniform to a texture, up to 7 on top of u_texture

applyshader.name: ApplyShader
applyshader.doc: A new texture of the same size: this one drawn through the shader. Draw it like any other, free it with UnloadTexture

applyshaderinto.name: ApplyShaderInto
applyshaderinto.doc: ApplyShader into a texture you already have, of any size, for doing it every frame

loadtexture.name: LoadTexture
loadtexture.doc: Load an image (png, jpg, bmp, tga) from Engine.blfs, returns a texture handle (0 if it failed)

gettexturesize.name: GetTextureSize
gettexturesize.doc: Texture width and height in pixels

drawline.name: DrawLine
drawline.doc: Line between two points, 1 pixel thick

drawlinev.name: DrawLineV
drawlinev.doc: Line between two points, 1 pixel thick

drawrectangle.name: DrawRectangle
drawrectangle.doc: Filled rectangle, x/y is the top-left corner

drawrectanglepro.name: DrawRectanglePro
drawrectanglepro.doc: Rotated rectangle, origin is the pivot relative to its top-left, rotation in degrees

drawrectanglelinesex.name: DrawRectangleLinesEx
drawrectanglelinesex.doc: Rectangle outline with a thickness (drawn inside the rect)

drawtext.name: DrawText
drawtext.doc: Draw text with the default font, numbers and vectors are printed too

drawtext3d.name: DrawText3D
drawtext3d.doc: Text in the 3D world (inside BeginMode3D): centered on position, faces the camera, hidden by things in front of it. size = line height in world units, draw it after the solid things

measuretext.name: MeasureText
measuretext.doc: Width in pixels DrawText would use

textformat.name: TextFormat
textformat.doc: printf-style text: %d %i %u %x %c %f %.2f %e %g %s (any value) %%, a vector fills several number placeholders

drawtexture.name: DrawTexture
drawtexture.doc: Draw a texture at its own size, WHITE tint keeps its colors

drawtexturev.name: DrawTextureV
drawtexturev.doc: Draw a texture at its own size

drawtextureex.name: DrawTextureEx
drawtextureex.doc: Draw a texture rotated (degrees, around its top-left) and scaled

drawtexturerec.name: DrawTextureRec
drawtexturerec.doc: Draw part of a texture (sprite sheets), negative source width/height flips it

drawtexturepro.name: DrawTexturePro
drawtexturepro.doc: Draw part of a texture into any rectangle, rotated around origin

createcamera2d.name: CreateCamera2D
createcamera2d.doc: Create a 2D camera: target (world) is shown at offset (screen), returns a handle

setcamera2dtarget.name: SetCamera2DTarget
setcamera2dtarget.doc: World point the camera looks at

setcamera2doffset.name: SetCamera2DOffset
setcamera2doffset.doc: Screen point the target appears at (usually the screen center)

beginmode2d.name: BeginMode2D
beginmode2d.doc: Draw the following 2D calls through this camera

getscreentoworld2d.name: GetScreenToWorld2D
getscreentoworld2d.doc: Screen pixel to world position (e.g. mouse to world)

createcamera3d.name: CreateCamera3D
createcamera3d.doc: Create a perspective camera looking at target, fovy in degrees, returns a handle

setcameraposition.name: SetCameraPosition
setcameraposition.doc: Move the camera (keeps the direction it faces)

setcameratarget.name: SetCameraTarget
setcameratarget.doc: Turn the camera to look at a point

setcamerafovy.name: SetCameraFovy
setcamerafovy.doc: Vertical field of view in degrees

getcameratarget.name: GetCameraTarget
getcameratarget.doc: A point 1 unit in front of the camera

getcameraright.name: GetCameraRight
getcameraright.doc: Camera's right direction, flat on the ground (length 1)

movecamera.name: MoveCamera
movecamera.doc: Move along the camera's own axes (up is world up)

walkcamera.name: WalkCamera
walkcamera.doc: Move along the ground: looking up or down doesn't change the height

rotatecamera.name: RotateCamera
rotatecamera.doc: Turn by degrees: yaw left/right, pitch up/down (clamped to +-89)

updatecamerafree.name: UpdateCameraFree
updatecamerafree.doc: Free-fly controls: WASD, space/ctrl up/down, shift fast, hold right mouse to look

beginmode3d.name: BeginMode3D
beginmode3d.doc: Draw the following calls in 3D through this camera

endmode3d.name: EndMode3D
endmode3d.doc: Back to screen-space 2D (draw your HUD after this)

getworldtoscreen.name: GetWorldToScreen
getworldtoscreen.doc: Screen pixel of a 3D point (far off screen if it's behind the camera)

drawcubetexture.name: DrawCubeTexture
drawcubetexture.doc: Cube with a texture on every face

drawplane.name: DrawPlane
drawplane.doc: Flat rectangle on the ground (XZ), facing up

drawgrid.name: DrawGrid
drawgrid.doc: Grid on the ground centered on the origin

loadmodel.name: LoadModel
loadmodel.doc: Load a glTF model (.glb, or .gltf with its .bin/images) from Engine.blfs, returns a handle (0 if it failed)

unloadmodel.name: UnloadModel
unloadmodel.doc: Free a model and its textures

drawmodel.name: DrawModel
drawmodel.doc: Draw a model, WHITE tint keeps its colors

drawmodelex.name: DrawModelEx
drawmodelex.doc: Draw a model rotated by angle degrees around axis, scaled per axis

getmodelboundsmin.name: GetModelBoundsMin
getmodelboundsmin.doc: Smallest corner of the model's bounding box (model space)

getmodelboundsmax.name: GetModelBoundsMax
getmodelboundsmax.doc: Largest corner of the model's bounding box (model space)

createmodelinstance.name: CreateModelInstance
createmodelinstance.doc: A copy of a model with its own node poses, returns a handle (0 if it failed), UnloadModel frees its instances too

destroymodelinstance.name: DestroyModelInstance
destroymodelinstance.doc: Free an instance, its model stays loaded

drawmodelinstance.name: DrawModelInstance
drawmodelinstance.doc: Draw an instance with its current node poses, WHITE tint keeps its colors

drawmodelinstanceex.name: DrawModelInstanceEx
drawmodelinstanceex.doc: Draw an instance rotated by angle degrees around axis, scaled per axis

findmodelnode.name: FindModelNode
findmodelnode.doc: Find a node of the default scene by its glTF name or a path like "Left/Door", returns a handle (0 if there is none), logs when the name is missing or not unique

findmodelnodeat.name: FindModelNodeAt
findmodelnodeat.doc: The index-th node (from 0, in scene order) with this name or path, returns a handle (0 if there is none)

countmodelnodes.name: CountModelNodes
countmodelnodes.doc: How many nodes have this name or path

getnodeboundsmin.name: GetNodeBoundsMin
getnodeboundsmin.doc: Smallest corner of the node's own mesh in the node's space, a good source for a pivot

getnodeboundsmax.name: GetNodeBoundsMax
getnodeboundsmax.doc: Largest corner of the node's own mesh in the node's space

getnodepivot.name: GetNodePivot
getnodepivot.doc: The point of the node's mesh it rotates and scales around

setnodepivot.name: SetNodePivot
setnodepivot.doc: Rotate and scale around this point of the node's mesh, like a door's hinge. The node stays where it is, GetNodePosition can change to make up for it

getnodeposition.name: GetNodePosition
getnodeposition.doc: Node position relative to its parent

setnodeposition.name: SetNodePosition
setnodeposition.doc: Move a node relative to its parent, its children follow

getnoderotation.name: GetNodeRotation
getnoderotation.doc: Node rotation as degrees around x, y and z, matches SetNodeRotationEuler

setnoderotation.name: SetNodeRotation
setnoderotation.doc: Replace a node's rotation with angle degrees around axis, it turns around its pivot

setnoderotationeuler.name: SetNodeRotationEuler
setnoderotationeuler.doc: Replace a node's rotation: roll around z, then pitch around x, then yaw around y

rotatenode.name: RotateNode
rotatenode.doc: Add angle degrees around axis to a node's current rotation

getnodescale.name: GetNodeScale
getnodescale.doc: Node scale relative to its parent

setnodescale.name: SetNodeScale
setnodescale.doc: Scale a node relative to its parent

getnodeworldposition.name: GetNodeWorldPosition
getnodeworldposition.doc: Node position relative to the model, with every parent applied (before DrawModelInstance places it)

setcamerafromnode.name: SetCameraFromNode
setcamerafromnode.doc: Put a 3D camera at a node, looking down the node's -Z like a glTF camera

loadscene.name: LoadScene
loadscene.doc: Load a glTF file that is the level, returns an instance handle (0 if it failed) so every node function works on it

unloadscene.name: UnloadScene
unloadscene.doc: Free a scene, its model and every other instance of that model

drawscene.name: DrawScene
drawscene.doc: Draw a scene where its nodes are, use it inside BeginMode3D

getsceneroot.name: GetSceneRoot
getsceneroot.doc: Node handle of the first root of the scene, moving it moves everything under it

getdrawcalls.name: GetDrawCalls
getdrawcalls.doc: Draw calls of the last 3D or 2D block, read it after EndMode3D/EndMode2D

getmeshbinds.name: GetMeshBinds
getmeshbinds.doc: How many times a mesh was bound in the last block, copies of a mesh in one model share a bind

gettexturebinds.name: GetTextureBinds
gettexturebinds.doc: How many times a texture was bound in the last block

getculledobjects.name: GetCulledObjects
getculledobjects.doc: Model nodes skipped in the last block because they were outside the camera's view

setfrustumculling.name: SetFrustumCulling
setfrustumculling.doc: Skip model nodes outside the camera's view (on by default), turn it off to compare

pow.name: Pow
pow.doc: x to the power of y

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.doc: Keep a value inside a range

getrandomvalue.name: GetRandomValue
getrandomvalue.doc: Random int, min and max included

vector2.name: Vector2
vector2.doc: Make a vec2 from numbers or variables

vector3.name: Vector3
vector3.doc: Make a vec3 from numbers or variables

getx.name: GetX
getx.doc: x of a vector (r of a color, x of a rect)

gety.name: GetY
gety.doc: y of a vector (g of a color, y of a rect)

getz.name: GetZ
getz.doc: z of a vec3/vec4 (b of a color, width of a rect)

getw.name: GetW
getw.doc: w of a vec4/quat (a of a color, height of a rect)
